review:
Black Friday Madness is a BGaming slot that turns a shopping stampede into a 5x4 game with 60 paylines and a coin-based hold and win round. The theme is the chaos around Black Friday: discounted products, fierce shoppers and plenty of loot on the shelves. BGaming calls it a social-horror slot and it follows their earlier Ultras release in tone, so the characters are deliberately exaggerated.

The numbers are easy to read: RTP 97%, medium volatility, a hit rate of 6.75 and a maximum win of 5,000x. The main feature is the coin-filled hold and win bonus, where coins lock in place and respins keep going while new coins land. Try the free demo to see the store setting; the medium volatility and simple mechanics make this a slot for players who want regular action rather than a long wait for one big round.
